source_title: MDOT SHA Oversize/Overweight Hauling Permit Manual (fees: COMAR 11.04.01.08)
verify_reasons: Live sourcing attempted + blocked: the official MDOT SHA Hauling Permit Manual PDF returned HTTP 522 and the SHA overdimensional-limitations page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch this run. The escort matrix (over 13' = 1, 14'+ = 2, pole car over 14'6", police at 16' wide or 75 tons) and the superload (>120,000 lbs gross on non-Interstate) are cross-referenced from published summaries of that manual — confirm with MDOT SHA Hauling Permits (1-800-543-4564).
Single-trip fee formula ($30 first 40 tons + $5/ton over 40 tons) is from COMAR 11.04.01.08 (official Maryland regulation); verify current schedule.

superload_thresholds.note: MDOT SHA superload = over 120,000 lbs gross on non-Interstate routes (permit weights run up to 150,000 lbs on Interstate); superload applications require engineering/bridge review. Permit axle maxima: single 27,000 / tandem 52,000 / tridem 63,000 lbs. Dimensional superload thresholds not published as fixed numbers — null flags for manual verification.

width.note: 1 escort over 13' wide on any highway (except manufactured-housing units)
2 escorts at 14' wide or more, including manufactured-housing units
police escort required at 16' wide or more

height.note: pole (height) escort vehicle required over 14'6" high

weight.note: police escort required at 75 tons (150,000 lbs) gross or more

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip OS/OW permit = $30 for the first 40 tons (80,000 lbs) or less of gross weight, plus $5 for each additional ton (or part of a ton) over 40 tons (COMAR 11.04.01.08).
single_trip.note: Permit valid 5 travel days. 'Wide Load'/'Oversize Load' signs required over 9' wide, front and rear.

annual.note: Annual/blanket hauling permits available for qualifying repetitive moves; fee per COMAR schedule — quote through MDOT SHA.

movement_restrictions: Daylight movement typical for over-dimensional loads; escorts maintain two-way radio contact and constant communication
Private escort must carry at least one 3" oscillating/rotating yellow roof light visible front and rear, with headlights on during the move
Police escort required for moves 16' wide or more, 75 tons gross or more, or where road/weather conditions or travel against traffic warrant
notes: Legal limits: width 8'6" (102"), height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; 53' semitrailer on the National Network.
Escort matrix and superload from published MDOT SHA Hauling Permit Manual summaries (official PDF 522 / SHA page 403 this run); single-trip fee formula from COMAR 11.04.01.08.
